results.title: Duke University Board of Trustees increase tuition to nearly 5% for the fourth year in a row
results.snippet: On Tuesday, the Board of Trustees approved a 4.9% increase in the total cost of attendance for Duke undergraduates in 2026-27 during their quarterly meeting. That means for next year’s freshmen attending Duke, tuition is now $73,740 and the new cost of attendance — which the board said includes room, board and other fees — is $96,597.
